description: Get one quiz by ID, found with list_quizzes. If the ID belongs to a New Quiz, Canvas returns only its stub row (quiz_type: quizzes.next) — use list_new_quiz_items for the actual question content. Returns title, quiz_type, points_possible, question_count, due_at, published state, and assignment_id (the graded assignment Canvas created for this quiz; null for an ungraded survey or practice quiz). Use list_quiz_questions for a Classic quiz's fixed questions and list_quiz_submissions for student attempts.
name: get_quiz
title: Get Quiz
